mechanism.claim: When completed BTC spot and perpetual eight-hour returns agree, the perpetual contract overshoots spot in that common direction, realized variation is elevated, and open interest contracts, the excess perpetual displacement is liquidation-driven without fresh leveraged sponsorship and should reverse over eight hours.
mechanism.side: opposite strict sign of the completed eight-hour BTC perpetual return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSPOICR requires an exact completed-range close location with exact OI contraction and variation. No prior composite event set or control is reused; it uses no spot, ETH, funding, premium-index, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour spot-perpetual overshoot plus OI-contraction exhaustion states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, each exchange-timestamped no later than D
features.perpetual_return: sum of 480 one-minute log(close/open) BTCUSDT perpetual returns, finite strict nonzero
features.spot_return: sum of the synchronized 480 one-minute log(close/open) BTCUSDT spot returns, finite strict nonzero
features.direction_agreement: perpetual_return and spot_return have the same strict sign
features.directional_perpetual_overshoot: sign(perpetual_return)*(perpetual_return-spot_return)>0, strict with no fitted magnitude threshold
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute perpetual log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent synchronized bars [D-8h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact coherent synchronized 480-row spot and perpetual cycles, strict direction agreement, strict directional perpetual overshoot, two exact OI endpoints with strict contraction, and the variation rank passes at D

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance and bars_binance_spot BTCUSDT exact synchronized coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or contraction rule, spot-perpetual agreement or overshoot rule, variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
